brief: Goldman's Prime Services update tracks hedge fund performance through the October 30, 2026 US close, following an earlier noon-EST estimate. At noon, markets had sold off broadly led by Tech (NDX down more than 3%), with Global Fundamental L/S managers down 1.2% and Systematic L/S managers down 0.6%, losses from Asia and Europe partly offset by US gains. Into the close, equities recovered partially but still finished lower: Fundamental managers trimmed some of their intraday losses to -0.85% (beta/Info Tech driven, -3.3% MTD, +9.3% YTD), while Systematic (quant) managers slipped slightly further to -0.7% (-1.9 SD), posting their first negative month of the year (-3.7% MTD) on momentum, crowding and short-term-signal drags, though still up 16% YTD. Multi-Strats (4.5x leverage, no fees) finished flat, -0.9% MTD. By style/region at the close: TMT -3.1% (-11.9% MTD, +5.7% YTD), US -0.8%, Europe -0.5%, Asia -1.3%. The note reports data; it does not argue a forward thesis.
